name: Failed Experiment
description: A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them warped and ungainly.

abilities.name: Warped Fortitude
abilities.description: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.

abilities.name: Overwhelm
abilities.description: When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within Very Close range, the Experiment deals double damage.

abilities.name: Lurching Lunge
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending Fear.
